caption: One click before you run a query, and SSMS shows you exactly what SQL Server did.
Read right-to-left, bottom-to-top: scans and seeks feed joins, which feed the SELECT.

code:
-- No index on Name: Clustered Index Scan
SELECT ProductID, Name, ListPrice
FROM Production.Product
WHERE Name = N'Chainring Bolts';

-- Add the index...
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_Product_Name
ON Production.Product (Name);

-- ...same query is now an Index Seek
caption: Same query, same result — the plan operator is what changed.
